prompt: Inside a warm bakery, a baker in a white apron stands behind a glass counter on the left, handing a croissant wrapped in paper to a customer. The customer, a woman in a beige coat, reaches out with her right hand to accept the pastry while holding a leather purse in her left. On the counter, three golden-brown loaves of bread sit on a wooden board in the center, emitting visible steam. To the right, a tray of chocolate muffins is being placed down by a second employee wearing gloves. In the foreground, a jar of colorful cookies sits next to a vintage cash register. A hanging scale dangles from the ceiling above the counter, its brass pan empty. Behind the baker, shelves are stocked with flour sacks and mixing bowls. Warm ambient light streams through the window on the far right, illuminating dust particles and creating soft shadows on the tiled floor. The textures of the crusty bread and smooth glass are rendered with high fidelity. The scene captures a quiet morning transaction with natural lighting and detailed surfaces. This is a photorealistic photo.
